parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fda_approvals WHERE approval_date >= '{{$json.period_start}}') as fda_approvals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinical_trials WHERE start_date >= '{{$json.period_start}}') as new_trials,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM funding_rounds WHERE announcement_date >= '{{$json.period_start}}') as funding_rounds,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_usd), 0) FROM funding_rounds WHERE announcement_date >= '{{$json.period_start}}') as total_funding,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM publications WHERE publication_date >= '{{$json.period_start}}') as publications,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM press_releases WHERE published_date >= '{{$json.period_start}}') as press_releases

=SELECT c.name, f.device_name, f.approval_date, f.fda_number 
FROM fda_approvals f 
JOIN companies c ON f.company_id = c.id 
WHERE f.approval_date >= '{{$node['Set Report Period'].json.period_start}}' 
ORDER BY f.approval_date DESC LIMIT 20

=SELECT c.name, fr.round_type, fr.amount_usd, fr.announcement_date 
FROM funding_rounds fr 
JOIN companies c ON fr.company_id = c.id 
WHERE fr.announcement_date >= '{{$node['Set Report Period'].json.period_start}}' 
ORDER BY fr.amount_usd DESC LIMIT 10
